### Callout.Action

<ParamField body="Action.className" type="string | ((state: ButtonState) =&gt; string | undefined)">
  CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
  returns a class based on the component's state.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Action.color" type="&quot;accent&quot; | &quot;danger&quot; | &quot;neutral&quot; | &quot;success&quot;">
  Semantic color of the button.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Action.elevated" type="boolean">
  Adds a shadow and backdrop blur. Neutral outline buttons also use elevated surface colors.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Action.endIcon" type="ReactNode">
  Decorative content displayed after the label.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Action.focusableWhenDisabled" type="boolean" default="false">
  Whether the button should be focusable when disabled.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Action.fullWidth" type="boolean">
  Expands the button to fill its container width.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Action.href" type="string">
  Destination URL. Renders a native anchor when `render` is omitted unless `nativeButton` is explicitly true. Custom renderers retain their own element contract.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Action.loading" type="boolean">
  Shows a loading indicator and disables activation.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Action.loadingPosition" type="&quot;center&quot; | &quot;end&quot; | &quot;start&quot;">
  Where the loading indicator appears. `center` hides the content while preserving its layout space; `start` and `end` keep children and the opposite icon visible and replace the corresponding icon with the spinner.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Action.nativeButton" type="boolean" default="true">
  Whether the rendered root is a native button. Defaults to true for custom renderers. The built-in `href` anchor defaults to false; an explicit value takes precedence.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Action.render" type="ReactElement&lt;unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor&lt;any&gt;&gt; | ComponentRenderFn&lt;HTMLProps, ButtonState&gt;">
  Caller-supplied root element or renderer. Native attributes, handlers, event details, and refs reach the rendered root. Use `nativeButton={false}` and `role="link"` for a custom navigation anchor. Router integration belongs to the caller.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Action.role" type="AriaRole">
  Role of the root element. Use `link` for custom navigation renderers.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Action.shortcut" type="ShortcutDefinition">
  Flat key array for simultaneous keys, or nested key arrays for an ordered sequence. Displayed on non-mobile screens.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Action.shortcutJoinLabel" type="string">
  Localized text between sequence steps. Defaults to then.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Action.startIcon" type="ReactNode">
  Decorative content displayed before the label.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Action.style" type="CSSProperties | ((state: ButtonState) =&gt; CSSProperties | undefined)">
  Style applied to the element, or a function that
  returns a style object based on the component's state.
</ParamField>
